milestone: H2-v2 M2f — fresh raw-to-DB quantity-reduction diagnosis
purpose: Use a fresh immutable websocket evidence capture to localize the quantity-reduction divergence observed in H2-v2 M2/M2b without inspecting strategy performance.

primary_hypothesis.name: trade_book_transition_without_price_change
primary_hypothesis.statement: Trade-driven book quantity mutations may be represented by websocket book snapshots without a corresponding price_change carrying the quantity reduction.
primary_hypothesis.basis: Polymarket documents book as emitted on subscription and when a trade affects the book, while price_change is documented for new order placement and cancellation.

capture_plan.extension_rule: If the frozen evidence minimum is not met after 30 minutes, continue the same capture without analysis until 60 minutes total.
capture_plan.stop_rule: Stop after 30 minutes if minimum evidence is met; otherwise stop at 60 minutes.

eligible_checkpoint_pair.checkpoint_event: next ws_book for the same token

reconciliation_tests.raw_frame_integrity: Recompute SHA256 over exact UTF-8 raw frame and require equality with stored raw_frame_sha256.
reconciliation_tests.raw_to_normalized: Every relevant H2-v2 raw event must map exactly to the expected normalized evidence record using connection_id, raw_frame_sequence, raw_frame_sha256, ingest_sequence and change_index.
reconciliation_tests.normalized_to_database: Every normalized price_change must map exactly to book_deltas and every normalized ws_book checkpoint must map exactly to book_snapshots using token, connection_id, ingest_sequence, change_index, book_generation and event fields.
reconciliation_tests.replay: Starting from the base ws_book full state, apply intervening price_change level sizes using the same absolute-level replacement convention used by M2/M2b, then compare exact price-level membership and size against the next ws_book checkpoint.
reconciliation_tests.raw_event_interval: For every replay mismatch, inspect all same-token raw websocket events between the two ws_book boundary frames.

required_conditions: replay differs from terminal ws_book size
same-token last_trade_price raw event occurs after the base ws_book frame and before or at the checkpoint ws_book frame
trade_book_transition_rule.interpretation: Supports, but does not by itself prove, that the checkpoint book mutation is trade-driven rather than a dropped price_change.

fresh_nonreproduction_rule.condition: Frozen minimum evidence is met and every eligible pair is an exact replay match.
